newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Runaway Russian soldiers kill driver, steal car.
newsitem.headline: Runaway Russian soldiers kill driver, steal car.

text.p: Three Russian army sergeants were on the run on Monday after shooting dead the driver of a car they hijacked, Russian media said.

Itar-Tass news agency said one of the three had been due to face a court-martial on Monday but had apparently fled the camp near the Urals city of Yekaterinburg with the aid of two comrades on night-time sentry duty.
Having stabbed another soldier and comandeered a military vehicle to make their getaway, they later stopped a car and shot the driver in the head. Police across the region joined the hunt.
Violence among soldiers has become commonplace as economic hardships have caused a slump in conditions and morale for Russia's 1.8 million servicemen.
